CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.llm_firewall_append_tenant_audit(p_tenant_id text, p_created_at_unix bigint, p_path text, p_outcome text, p_status_code integer, p_latency_ms bigint, p_audit_max_rows bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO tenant_audit
                    (tenant_id, created_at_unix, path, outcome, status_code, latency_ms)
                VALUES
                    (p_tenant_id, p_created_at_unix, p_path, p_outcome, p_status_code, p_latency_ms);
                -- Only one concurrent writer prunes at a time. Other writes
                -- never wait for a table-wide lock; retention converges after
                -- in-flight events finish.
                IF pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(841_337_611) THEN
                    DELETE FROM tenant_audit
                    WHERE id IN (
                        SELECT id FROM tenant_audit
                        ORDER BY id DESC
                        OFFSET p_audit_max_rows
                    );
                END IF;
            END;
            $function$
functions.name: llm_firewall_append_tenant_audit

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.llm_firewall_reject_immutable_policy_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
                 BEGIN
                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant policy history is immutable';
                 END;
                 $function$
functions.name: llm_firewall_reject_immutable_policy_change

 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$

                 END;
                 $function$
